We need to summarize Raymond III, Count of Tripoli. Let's recall his life: Raymond III (c. 1140 – 1187) was Count of Tripoli from 1152 to 1187, also Prince of Galilee and Tiberias through marriage. He was a key noble in the Kingdom of Jerusalem, involved in politics, alliances with Byzantium, conflicts with Saladin, participated in Battle of Hattin (1187) where he escaped, died shortly after. He was son of Raymond II and Hodierna of Jerusalem. He married Eschiva of Bures, Princess of Galilee. He had a conflict with King Baldwin IV and later with Guy of Lusignan. He attempted to negotiate with Saladin, but after the defeat at Hattin he retired to Tripoli where he died in 1187. His descendants included Bohemond VII etc.
